title: Notifications in Papyrus: console, CLI, plugin and site rollout for the Caducus service
description:
Service and plan live on the Caducus board (AnthusAI/Caducus, initiative kanbus-90737c, docs/notifications-plan.md). Word this feature 'notifications', never 'Notification Center', which here means review requests.

The Papyrus side of Anthus notifications. Earlier epics here were moved to Caducus and closed under PPY-7d8a36. Existing work reused: newsletter plugin, email_render, publish_alerts, review requests stay as they are. Stories for M2 and M3 are detailed; Slack and Discord UI are coarse.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Reworked 2026-11-04, Ryan's reversal: this board now holds all the hosting. First slice: PPY-d21c7f, PPY-bf63d5, PPY-e92c8e, PPY-dd8c18, PPY-e82423. The plan is docs/notifications-plan.md in AnthusAI/Caducus.
